note: A 16:9 film, so every graphic is horizontal. The script asks for the hook text, the place tag, five lower thirds, one number pop and two highlight lines (10), then the end card.

mg.title: Hook question

text.main: What has she meant to you?

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “What has she meant to you?” Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Top of the frame.

mg.title: Place tag
mg.cue: Location tag at 00:06 for 3 s, upper left: “The Haven”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:06 over the drone shot for 3 s. Upper left.

mg.title: Nathan lower third
mg.cue: Name super at 00:09 for 2 s, lower left: “Nathan Smith” / CEO, CASS
mg.use: Put it on at 00:09 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <CEO, CASS> under the name.

mg.title: 130 units
mg.cue: Number pop at 00:10 in the top band: “130” units for people 55 and older
mg.use: Put it on at 00:10 as he says 130, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Nicole lower third
mg.cue: Name super at 00:13 for 3 s, lower left: “Nicole Peña” / Chief Development Officer, CASS
mg.use: Put it on at 00:13 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Chief Development Officer, CASS> under the name.

mg.title: Bessie lower third
mg.cue: Name super at 00:30 for 3 s, lower left: “Bessie” / Resident, The Haven
mg.use: Put it on at 00:30 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Resident, The Haven> under the name.

mg.title: We had safety

text.main: The main thing is that we had safety

mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 01:05 for 3 s: “The main thing is that we had safety”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, about 01:05, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Gabriela lower third
mg.cue: Name super at 01:09 for 3 s, lower left: “Gabriela” / Shelter Support, The Haven
mg.use: Put it on at 01:09 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Shelter Support, The Haven> under the name. First name only.

mg.title: Each other

text.main: We need the strength of each other to move forward

mg.cue: Highlight text in the top band at 01:20 for 3 s: “We need the strength of each other to move forward”
mg.use: Put it on as she says it, about 01:20, for 3 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Barbara lower third
mg.cue: Name super at 01:27 for 3 s, lower left: “Barbara” / Resident, The Haven
mg.use: Put it on at 01:27 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <Resident, The Haven> under the name.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry). The CASS name is typed in CASS navy until the logo file is added to endcards/cass/. Wording from the client file: cassaz.org.
mg.use: After the drone wide at 01:39. Hold it to the end. Music fades out over 1 s.
